advice.en: No registered company: open as an individual. Creem, Dodo Payments and Waffo Pancake take individuals in mainland China, and Paddle accepts individuals and sole traders anywhere outside its sanctions list.
advice.zh: 没注册公司，就用个人开。Creem、Dodo Payments、Waffo Pancake 都接受中国大陆个人，Paddle 也接受个人和个体经营（制裁名单以外的国家都行）。

advice.en: Dodo's line between the two: an individual is a creator or sole proprietor paid personally, with no company registration or business tax ID; a registered entity has a tax ID and is paid to the company's bank account.
advice.zh: Dodo 给的分法：个人是创作者或个体经营，钱进你本人的账户，没有公司注册和税号；注册实体有税号，钱进公司的对公账户。

advice.en: Creem pays a mainland individual to Alipay: up to CNY 50,000 a payout and CNY 300,000–600,000 a year. Past that, a company's bank account.
advice.zh: Creem 给大陆个人打款到支付宝：单笔最多 5 万元，每年 30–60 万元。超过这个量，要用公司的对公账户。

advice.en: Stripe opens for neither individuals nor companies in mainland China: a Hong Kong individual account needs a Hong Kong ID number and a US one an SSN or ITIN, so a mainland founder opens with a Hong Kong or US company. Polar pays out only through Stripe, so the same holds.
advice.zh: Stripe 不给中国大陆个人或公司开户：香港个人户要香港身份证号，美国个人户要 SSN 或 ITIN，所以大陆创业者要用香港或美国公司开；Polar 只能通过 Stripe 出款，也一样。

advice.en: A company on Waffo Pancake is still paid as a person for now: company payout accounts are 'being finalized', so payouts go to the verified individual.
advice.zh: 在 Waffo Pancake 用公司开户，目前还是按个人收款：公司收款账户「正在完善」，钱打到验证过身份的个人。

advice.en: Switching later from individual to company means a business verification and a new bank check (Dodo), so pick the one you will keep.
advice.zh: 以后从个人改成公司，要补公司验证、重新验证银行账户（Dodo 如此），所以按你打算长期用的身份选。

advice.en: How the income is taxed at home is a question for an accountant: this guide covers what the platforms ask for, not tax.
advice.zh: 收入在国内怎么报税，请问会计：这里只写平台的要求，不涉及税务。

facts.en: Incorporating online costs HK$1,545; the business registration fee and levy are paid with it (HK$2,350 for one year from 1 April 2026), so about HK$3,895 in all.
facts.zh: 网上注册 1,545 港元，商业登记费和征费同时交（2026 年 4 月 1 日起一年 2,350 港元），合计约 3,895 港元。

facts.en: Non-residents may incorporate; the registered office must be in Hong Kong.
facts.zh: 非香港居民也可以注册；注册地址必须在香港。

facts.en: At least one director who is a natural person (need not live in Hong Kong) and a company secretary who lives in Hong Kong or is a Hong Kong company; a sole director cannot also be the secretary.
facts.zh: 至少一名自然人董事（可以不住香港），加一名公司秘书（个人须常住香港，或是香港公司）；唯一的董事不能兼任秘书。

facts.en: No minimum paid-up capital; electronic certificates are normally issued within an hour.
facts.zh: 没有最低实缴资本；电子证书通常一小时内发出。

name.en: A US company through Stripe Atlas
name.zh: 用 Stripe Atlas 注册美国公司

facts.en: US$500 once, including Delaware fees and the first year of the registered agent; the agent is US$100 a year after that.
facts.zh: 一次性 500 美元，含特拉华州政府费和第一年注册代理；之后注册代理每年 100 美元。

facts.en: A Delaware C corporation or LLC; Atlas gets the EIN, which takes 10–35 business days for a founder without an SSN.
facts.zh: 可以选特拉华 C 类公司或 LLC；Atlas 代办 EIN，没有 SSN 的创始人要 10–35 个工作日。

facts.en: US card payments and payouts (up to US$100,000) can start before the EIN arrives; a franchise tax report is due every year by 1 March.
facts.zh: EIN 下来之前就能开通美国卡收款和出款（最多 10 万美元）；每年 3 月 1 日前要交特拉华特许税报告。

facts.en: Atlas does not guarantee approval for Stripe payments.
facts.zh: Atlas 不保证 Stripe 收款一定通过审核。

facts.en: Registering online with Companies House costs £100 and usually takes 24 hours (by post: £124, 8–10 days).
facts.zh: 在 Companies House 网上注册 100 英镑，通常 24 小时内完成（邮寄 124 英镑，8–10 天）。

facts.en: At least one director aged 16 or over, who need not live in the UK; a UK registered office address is required, and a PO box is not accepted.
facts.zh: 至少一名 16 岁以上的董事，可以不住英国；必须有英国注册地址，不能用邮政信箱。

facts.en: Directors verify their identity through GOV.UK One Login; the people with significant control (over 25% of shares or votes, for example) are named at registration. No company secretary is needed.
facts.zh: 董事要通过 GOV.UK One Login 验证身份；注册时要申报重大控制人（比如持股或投票权超过 25%）。不需要公司秘书。

fee.en: US account: 2.9% + 30¢, international cards +1.5%, currency conversion +1%. Hong Kong: 3.4% + HK$2.35, international +0.5%, conversion +2%. UK: international cards 3.15% + 20p, conversion +2%. Subscriptions through Stripe Billing +0.7%.
fee.zh: 美国账户 2.9% + 30 美分，国际卡 +1.5%，换汇 +1%；香港账户 3.4% + 2.35 港元，国际卡 +0.5%，换汇 +2%；英国账户国际卡 3.15% + 20 便士，换汇 +2%；用 Stripe Billing 收订阅另加 0.7%。

payout.en: to a bank account in the account's country (not a virtual account)
payout.zh: 打到账户所在国的银行账户（不接受虚拟账户）

review_time.en: activation after the website and business details check out
review_time.zh: 网站和公司信息核实后激活

chargebacks.en: card networks treat 0.7% as excessive; Stripe can hold a reserve when disputes rise
chargebacks.zh: 卡组织把 0.7% 视为过高；拒付变多时 Stripe 可能冻结一部分款项

en: Not a Merchant of Record: you handle sales tax and VAT yourself, or add Managed Payments (Stripe as MoR, +3.5%, for fully automated digital products; open to businesses in the US, Canada, 31 European countries, Australia, Hong Kong, Japan and Singapore).
zh: 不是 MoR：销售税和增值税要你自己报，或者开 Managed Payments（Stripe 代收税，每笔多收 3.5%，只卖全自动交付的数字产品；面向美国、加拿大、31 个欧洲国家、澳大利亚、香港、日本和新加坡的商家）。

note.en: no accounts for mainland China
note.zh: 不支持中国大陆开户

note.en: no accounts for mainland China; open with a Hong Kong or US company instead
note.zh: 不支持中国大陆，要用香港或美国公司开

note.en: a local bank account and address are needed
note.zh: 需要香港本地银行账户和地址

note.en: a US bank account and mailing address; a non-US owner without SSN gives a local tax ID
note.zh: 需要美国银行账户和通信地址；没有 SSN 的非美国负责人提供本国税号

note.en: a UK account: UK cards 1.5% + 20p, international cards 3.15% + 20p, +2% if currency conversion is needed
note.zh: 英国账户：英国卡 1.5% + 20 便士，国际卡 3.15% + 20 便士，需要换汇另加 2%

steps: Sign up, and test in a separate sandbox account (the sandbox needs no domain approval).

Submit each checkout domain under My Account → Settings → Website approval. The site must be live on HTTPS and show the product, prices, features, terms, refund and privacy policies; the terms must name you (your legal name as a sole trader) or the company. Most domains pass automatically; a manual review takes 5–7 business days.
Identity verification through Sumsub: a government ID and proof of address if asked, sometimes a short selfie video. It is usually instant.
Add payout details: bank transfer or Payoneer. CNY is paid by bank wire; a cross-currency SWIFT payout costs US$15.
Payouts are monthly: the balance above your threshold (minimum US$100) becomes a payout on the 1st and is sent by the 15th.

Choose the personal seller account and pass personal real-name verification (China residents aged 18 or over).
Add PayPal checkout to your site; payments from abroad cost 4.40% + US$0.30.
Bind a personal bank card for CNY collection: from US$20 a request, usually the same day before 13:00 Beijing time, 0.5% to the end of 2026 (1.0% standard) plus 6% VAT on the fee.

a personal bank card in mainland China
a website with PayPal checkout

caveat.en: Counted from public checkout links found in backlink data, sellers worldwide. Checkouts a page opens with a script (Paddle.js, Stripe Checkout sessions) leave no link, so Paddle and embedded Stripe are undercounted; Gumroad and Stripe Payment Links are overcounted for the same reason.
caveat.zh: 数据来自外链里公开出现的收款链接，全球卖家；页面用脚本打开的结账（Paddle.js、Stripe Checkout）不留链接，所以 Paddle 和嵌入式 Stripe 被低估，Gumroad 和 Stripe 收款链接相对被高估。
